blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Adults and Children 14 years of age and older: Chew four (4) tablets daily. Children 4 years of age and older: Chew two (2) tablets daily. Not for younger children.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Dextrose, natural and artificial flavors, magnesium stearate, sucralose, microcrystalline cellulose, silicon dioxide.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not take if pregnant, breastfeeding, on medication, or with a known medical condition unless you have consulted a physician.
Always consult your pediatrician before giving your child dietary supplements.
Keep out of reach of children.
Protected with a tamper evident seal. Do not use if seal under cap is broken or missing.
Store in a cool, dry place with lid tightly closed.
